name: @avatark/navigation
description: Shared navigation contract: viewer-state vocabulary (anonymous/signed_in/admin) and 'next product' resolution built on @avatark/product-registry's nextProductIds. Contract only this phase -- InstitutionalHeader/EchoHeader/EchoAvatarMenu/AdminNav remain separate, unmigrated UI implementations, and the 'return to Avatar' decision (lib/journey/continuity.ts) stays app-specific, not packaged, since it depends on this app's own PrometheusK-URL/intention/witness content.
